idea-plugin.name: JUnit Test Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Rule-based JUnit test generator. Works fully offline: no network access and no LLM.
  • Generates a given/when/then test for every non-private method (JUnit 5 or JUnit 4).
  • Collaborator fields become @Mocks; calls made on them become when(...).thenReturn(...) stubs and verify(...) checks.
  • Creates disabled exception-test skeletons for declared throws clauses.
  • Merges only missing tests into an existing test class.
Use Code → Generate… → JUnit 테스트 생성 in the editor, or right-click files/packages in the Project view.
